question: By whose agency and will does the yoginī named Icchā extend up to māyā?
premises: The siddhas are involved as agents.
The action occurs by supreme will up to māyā.
inference: The yoginī Icchā, through the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to māyā.
uncertainties: The main verb is implicit, making the exact action unclear.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to māyā.
